'''Jisan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] merchant of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] residing on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jisan appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Contraband Resale reputation vendor.
